info.title: Linkplane local API
info.description: A transport adapter over linkplaned (docs/local-api-design.md, ADR 0012). Loopback only. Every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (linkplane clients create); tokens are never accepted in the URL. Public contracts describe Linkplane's domain, not its internal vocabulary.

get.description: Frames: `event: stream` once (control: protocol, last_seq, resumed_after, gap), then `event: event` with `id:` = seq. Resume with `after=<seq>` or `Last-Event-ID: <seq>` (after wins); both mean seq > N. Replay from history then live, no duplicates within a connection, strictly increasing seq. Browser clients use fetch() streaming with the Authorization header.

get.description: Read backwards from the end of the log, bounded by `limit`; sensitive keys (clipboard text, commands, stdout, tokens, credentials) are redacted in the projection, never in the file. `device` is the registry name pinned records carry; `device_id` is the canonical id resolved at read time, null when the name no longer resolves (renamed/removed profile, `*`).

bearer.description: token from `linkplane clients create`; header only

name.description: registry name (alias); the value pinned records carry in `device`

granted.description: authorization metadata about the calling client, not device state

action.description: capability name; execution mode is declared per action (x-actions)

parameters.description: the service Request fields the action accepts (see x-actions)

Job.description: JobRecord as persisted, plus the public vocabulary: `action` is the public capability name (backup.photos), `job_action` the record's own rules/jobs name (backup); `rule` aliases `automation` (null for API-started jobs). `device` is the registry name pinned records carry; `device_id` is the canonical id resolved at read time, null when the name no longer resolves (renamed/removed profile, `*`).

Event.description: Event.to_dict() as persisted (schema linkplane.event/1) plus `device_id`. `device` is the registry name pinned records carry; `device_id` is the canonical id resolved at read time, null when the name no longer resolves (renamed/removed profile, `*`).

command.description: run command text is never exposed

AuditEntry.description: linkplane.audit/2 line, redacted for HTTP; `action` is the public name when the entry's action is a job action (then `job_action` holds the original). `device` is the registry name pinned records carry; `device_id` is the canonical id resolved at read time, null when the name no longer resolves (renamed/removed profile, `*`).
